valueProps.title: Built on uncompromising trust & ceylon hospitality
valueProps.prop1Desc: Every listed vehicle must hold active comprehensive insurance. In the rare event of an incident, renters are only responsible for the policy excess deductible.
valueProps.prop2Desc: Digital pickup and return logs with high-resolution photographic audit trail, fuel calibration, and odometer verification signed by both parties.
valueProps.prop3Desc: Government NIC and driving license KYC checks ensure that only respectful renters and credible owners interact on the platform.
valueProps.prop4Desc: Security deposits are held in a safe digital escrow and released automatically upon clean inspection completion.

categories.carsDesc: Self-drive hatchbacks, sedans, and passenger vans with flexible per-day or mileage package rates for coastal getaways or family travel.
categories.luxuryDesc: Distinguished Mercedes-Benz, vintage convertibles, and ceremonial limousines driven by professional chauffeurs with bespoke floral packages.
categories.bikesDesc: Agile scooters and road bikes equipped with safety helmets to navigate Sri Lanka's scenic hill tracks and beach towns.
